findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/multi-model-ablation-replication.md:247 says the multi-model protocol should first do Tier-C M0 as "multi-key + B-4c65 revalidation" and directly reuse that M0, but the Tier-C execution plan defines M0 as only the threat model/key-management decision doc (lines 50-58), with cross-host review in M1 and pinned-key/signature provenance deferred to M-crypto (lines 60-107); the Tier-C threat model also says M0 has no implementation (lines 4-8). This blurs the M0/M1/M-crypto/M2 order and can imply already-available multi-key/runtime-ish quorum infrastructure.
